views.front:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Crownforge Spearwarden modular character parts atlas for continuous skeletal animation.
Primary request: Create exactly SIXTEEN isolated components of the SAME adult male Crown Spearwarden in reference1, in a FOUR COLUMN by FOUR ROW layout. Reference2 shows only the separate-parts layout and realistic material quality; do not copy that woman's identity. This is an exploded production parts atlas, never whole figures or animation poses.
Identity: ordinary veteran human spearman with shoulder-length brown hair, short brown moustache and beard, practical conical riveted iron cap with open visible face and NO plume, NO bronze helmet. Warm weathered brown sleeveless leather vest over pale ivory quilted linen tunic and sleeves. Royal-blue sash runs from the character's anatomical LEFT shoulder to anatomical RIGHT hip, same route in every view. Plain dark leather belt with brass buckle, pale ivory tunic skirt with narrow blue hem, fitted dark olive-brown wool trousers, dark brown practical leather boots and shin wraps, modest leather wrist protection. No ornamental bronze cuirass and no cape. Preserve existing Spearwarden identity while refining natural adult anatomy, tactile cloth quilting, seams, worn leather and brushed iron. Premium realistic sculpted 3D game artwork, subtle upper-left warm light and cool fill, crisp readable shapes, natural proportions.
Exact sixteen-part order:
Row1 column1: complete helmeted head with short neck, face/hair as appropriate to view; column2: sleeveless torso from neck to belt with vest and attached blue shoulder sash, NO arms, head, cloak or baked bare shoulders in sleeve openings (only fabric lining); column3: separate pale lower-tunic and hip belt from waist to above knees, with blue hem and small right-hip blue sash knot, NO legs; column4: ONE narrow separate hanging blue cloth sash END ONLY, isolated vertical strip with small knot at top, not a cape or full costume.
Row2 column1: anatomical LEFT upper arm in pale ivory quilted sleeve, shoulder joint TOP elbow BOTTOM; column2: RIGHT upper arm; column3: LEFT forearm sleeve and modest brown leather wrist cuff, elbow TOP wrist BOTTOM, NO hand; column4: RIGHT forearm similarly, NO hand.
Row3 column1: anatomical LEFT curled gripping hand, short wrist TOP and fingers BOTTOM loosely closed around EMPTY invisible vertical handle; column2: anatomical RIGHT curled gripping hand with correct separate thumb anatomy; column3: ONE LEFT trouser thigh, hip TOP knee BOTTOM; column4: ONE RIGHT trouser thigh. Every thigh is ONE individual leg segment, never shorts or two attached legs.
Row4 column1: LEFT trouser shin with leather wrap, knee TOP ankle BOTTOM NO foot; column2: RIGHT shin NO foot; column3: LEFT leather boot alone; column4: RIGHT leather boot alone. Boot ankle opening at top.
Rigging rules: Every limb hangs vertically straight, not bent or angled, rounded overlapping joint caps; left/right mean the character's own anatomy. Grip hands are closed relaxed fists with a small clear hole between curled fingers and thumb so a separate spear can attach, no splayed open palms. Do not place any weapon, spear, shield, tool or other object in the hands or body. No blood or interior anatomy, only clean textile/component cutouts.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha PNG, generous empty gutters between all sixteen complete parts. No painted checkerboard, matte, scene, floor, drop shadow, labels, text, grid or whole figures. No mirrored source sheet; author the actual directional surfaces.
VIEW CONTRACT: FRONT VIEW, faces the viewer from a modest20-degree elevated orthographic camera. Show face and front chest; blue sash runs screen-right shoulder diagonally to screen-left hip. Helmet iron cap front, front of tunic, front toes point toward viewer. Torso has no bare shoulder circles. Anatomical LEFT hand and LEFT arm would assemble on viewer-right; anatomical RIGHT parts on viewer-left.
